concept: Being good at something doesn't mean you can't still learn more about it
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character who is already good at something learns a new trick or tip from someone less experienced
exercise.reflection_prompt: How did the character feel learning something new about a thing they were already good at?
exercise.practice: Student names something they're good at and one thing they could still learn about it

assessment.success_marker: student names a real skill and a genuine, specific thing they could still learn
